summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared purpose is a shared commitlint configuration, but its `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh GitHub release URL, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with a shuffled numeric/string dictionary and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x...`), which is not readable to Node-based inspection. Fetching an alternate language runtime purely to execute an opaque bundled script on `npm install` is unrelated to any commitlint functionality, and the loader obfuscation plus payload obfuscation together indicate deliberate hiding from Node-based scanners. The result is arbitrary code execution on the installer's host at install time, with the executed bytes coming from a bundled artifact whose behavior cannot be verified.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
